text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This year's Classic division remains a 
chaotic brawl. Among the contenders, the 
most promising Umamusume are..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Found it! Lois and Lois!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's so tiny! I'm basically treated 
like a background extra!

Our first meeting of the new year. We were 
checking our progress toward our goals 
through racing magazines and special 
feature articles.
choice_data_list:
Every magazine feels pretty much the 
same...

Every magazine feels pretty much the 
same...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Among those receiving massive coverage is 
Biwa Hayahide, who boasts three 
consecutive wins since her debut and a 
2nd-place finish in a Junior-tier Gâ . And 
thenâ

Another is Winning Ticket, who has already 
claimed two victories at the Nakayama 
Racecourse 2000m—the same course as the 
"Satsuki Sho"—

Narita Taishin, with her sharp and 
sustained late surge, is also named as a 
strong contender.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...My abilities aren't rated as highly as 
theirs. To be honest, my growth has been 
stalling lately, too...

Indeed. Lately, Royce and Royce's times 
haven't been looking too good.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is an important 
turning point for self-producing as well.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the first race, the Satsuki 
Sho, is one I can't afford to miss if I 
want everyone to remember my name!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Will I be able to reach a level where I 
can compete with Hayahide and the others 
by the Satsuki Sho?
choice_data_list:
...To be honest, I have to say it's going 
to be tough.

text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce was developing slower than 
the other three. It was only natural due 
to individual differences, but at this 
stage, it clearly manifested as a gap in 
ability.

Furthermore, during this unstable period 
of growth, we cannot afford to push too 
hard in training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, if the gap in ability widens any 
further, we might have to reconsider our 
plan—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Even if exceptions are par for the course 
with any plan... things rarely go the way 
we want, do they?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not the only one facing hardships. 
There's Teio-san's injury too...

At late last year's Arima Kinen, Tokai 
Teio suffered a crushing defeat in an 
uncharacteristically poor run.

Shortly after the New Year, an injury to 
her left gluteus medius was discovered, 
and it was announced that she would be 
taking a break to recover.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She had just returned from her injury 
after the Japan Derby and once again 
demonstrated her strength in the Japan 
Cup, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what will become of Teio-san's 
'strongest' drama...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't have the luxury of worrying about 
other Umamusume right now!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's talk about our plans for the future!
choice_data_list:
Shall we think about our goals for this 
year?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds great! Let's see... It'll also 
help broaden your self-producing 
horizons—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I want to expand my potential as an actor! 
Maybe I should challenge myself with an 
experience that allows for that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Do you have any good ideas, Trainer?"

"Speaking of an experience that could 
broaden a character's potential—"
choice_data_list:
Seek guidance from the first Uma Musume 
you met

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Blazing a trail in the truest sense! 
Alright, let's go for it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Royce! A meeting even on New Year's? 
You're so dedicated!

She is Jungle Pocket. A spirited Umamusume 
who once even served as the head of a 
team.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Something in my very soul is telling 
me. Pokke-san, please make me your 
apprentice!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at you, all fired up! I don't 
normally take apprentices, but sure. 
Follow me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"If you don't wanna get looked down on, 
the start is what matters most. Put all 
your fighting spirit into your very first 
words."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Like this. Give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Put more power into it from your gut! Put 
some menace in your voice!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! Right now, I feel like I could overpower 
anyone! —Bring it on!

Royce and Royce mastered the powerhouse's 
spirited opening shout!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"A real-life board game... Ah, so you 
actually act out the instructions on the 
tiles."
choice_data_list:
They should be doing it at the shopping 
street event.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's go to the shopping 
district!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Next is my turn. Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Five! Eating street food from the 
butcher's. Eating two croquettes and two 
ham cutlets."
choice_data_list:
Whoa, they said Uma Musume get five times 
the amount...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ten croquettes and ten ham cutlets, got 
it. Well, this much should be fine.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A 6! Sweets tour trying out new treats. 
Eat dango, cake, and ice cream. Quantity 
multiplied by 5!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A 6! Scored free amazake and mochi! And 
both are multiplied by 5!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A 5! Freshly grilled carrot skewers from 
the greengrocer's♪ Give me five carrot 
skewers, please!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute... why is it that every 
single space I land on is just food?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if this is a sign from above that 
I should master the "big eater" persona...

Eating like a competitive big eater, Royce 
and Royce's stomach was completely 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so you mean finding a persona that 
matches the outfit from the lucky bag.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it might be best to have our 
advisor come along too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Flight-san! 
Please put together an outfit using this 
lucky bag!

She is the stylish fashionista North 
Flight. Word is she frequently gives 
fashion advice to many Tracen Academy 
students.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and try changing into it 
right away♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
These clothes are kind of different from 
what I expected...
choice_data_list:
Well, the goal this time is to build my 
character, so...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right, of course. Hmm, considering how to 
appeal to fans in this outfit—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Why don't you try taking off your 
glasses? I think it would really bring out 
your individuality, Royce-chan.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Glasses? Well, if Flight says so...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what do you think? Don't you think 
this allows for more flexible thinking?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, rather than going the 
intellectual butler route—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to my dear Trainer. With all my 
gratitude and love.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll be in your care again this year... 
Please look after me.

Royce and Royce mastered a brand-new 
character appeal!
